evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any biggest concerns or any important things that you want to answer during this call?' - asked before detailed logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's answer was mostly an item inventory (electronics, records, a bed to disassemble); rep acknowledged but never dug further with 'anything else?' - shallow.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'Would you like me to lock that in for you?'; 'if you still have extra time to prepare, put the small items into your boxes yourself... the less time you take the less money you end up spending. Does that make sense?' - 'Absolutely ma'am, this is very thorough, I appreciate this.'

top_strength: Extremely thorough and patient - handled a day-change request smoothly at the end and left the customer explicitly impressed ('I appreciate your time with this').
coaching_note: No quid pro quo framing was ever given before diving into probing questions - add the time-boxed ask-and-promise line up front.
